vocabulary.definition: a belief or practice resulting from ignorance, fear of the unknown, trust in magic or chance, or a false conception of causation
vocabulary.example: She always carries a lucky charm with her due to her superstition.

vocabulary.definition: historical records arranged in yearly sequence; historical records
vocabulary.example: The annals of the ancient civilization provided valuable insights into their culture.

vocabulary.definition: having great power, influence, or effect
vocabulary.example: The president's speech had a potent impact on the nation's opinion.

vocabulary.definition: the domination of one's thoughts or feelings by a persistent idea, image, or desire
vocabulary.example: His obsession with cleanliness led him to scrub the house daily.
The team's efforts to win the game were met with futility as they lost by a large margin.
